review: antimagic-review-r1 (A PASS, B PASS, C QUALIFIED_PASS, D QUALIFIED_PASS bounded, E QUALIFIED_PASS; PROCEED)

rulings.scope: Credit for the full resolution of the even case of Conjecture 6.1 of Baca, Semanicova-Fenovcikova, Lai and Wang (Fundamenta Informaticae 185 (2022)): chi_la(T) = l + 1 for every complete full t-ary tree T with t >= 2 even and every depth n >= 1.
rulings.lean_fidelity: REQUIRED: (i) literal local antimagic labelling and chi_la for a finite simple graph without K_2 components, as in source Definitions 1.1-1.3; (ii) a concrete model T(t,n) with a proof that it satisfies the source's structural definition (rooted; every non-leaf has exactly t children; all leaves at depth n); (iii) the endpoint chi_la(T(t,n)) = t^n + 1; and (iv) the bridge to ANY complete full t-ary tree: every finite rooted tree satisfying the structural definition is isomorphic to T(t,n), and chi_la is an isomorphism invariant. (iv) may be the last target, but it is required for acceptance.
rulings.attribution: The manuscript must credit the n = 2, t = 2 labelling to source Figure 5, use the published lemma numbering (Lemma 2.9 and 2.10; Conjecture 6.1), and flag the n = 2, t >= 4 case as built from source ingredients.
rulings.significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, modest: the source's own method provably cannot reach l + 1 (published Lemma 2.10 forces an extra colour); the symmetric-shell labelling with the permutation sigma is new. Unread prior-art leads (Sarath-Prajeesh 2023 on diameter-4 trees; Premalatha et al. 2022) could affect at most the n = 2 case.

decision: PROCEED to Lean (antimagic-formal-r1, Sol, next free slot); use the reviewer's piecewise parity formula for the labelling
